name: local-rag
description: Local semantic + keyword search across your Obsidian vault and source repos. Stdio MCP server; no cloud APIs, no telemetry.

repo_path.title: local-rag clone path
repo_path.description: Absolute path to your local-rag repository (the folder containing pyproject.toml).

uv_path.title: uv binary path
uv_path.description: Path to the uv binary. Leave as 'uv' if it's on PATH. If Cowork can't find it (common when Cowork is launched from the GUI rather than a terminal), set to the absolute path — usually /opt/homebrew/bin/uv on Apple Silicon, /usr/local/bin/uv on Intel.
